# Third-party marks

Other companies' logos, used only as their brand rules allow. Never recolor,
reshape, combine or put an effect on them.

| File | Source | Rule we follow |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `linkedin-in-black.png` | LinkedIn's official [in] logo pack (brand.linkedin.com/downloads → in-logo.zip, `InBug-Black.png`), scaled to 96px tall | Black is one of the three allowed colors; used as a hyperlink to a member's own LinkedIn profile, in a row of profile links — a permitted use. Not recolored to Graphite: LinkedIn forbids changing its color. |
| Slack mark — `components/portal/slack-mark.tsx` | The mark Slack serves on slack.com (a.slack-edge.com, nav/logo.svg), geometry unaltered | One-color version on Graphite; the full-color mark is for white, black or aubergine only. |
